**Needs changes before merge.** Two blockers: clippy fails, and the new create-door law changes the entry of an operation that a saved cut recipe makes.

Thank you for this fix. The two doors of #3863 now give the expected entry, and the pinning tests catch each half of the change.

## What looks good

- `add_operation {"kind":"2D Offset","params":{"pass_start":"outside"}}` now gives `entry: arc` (issue probe 1).
- `edit_operation {"params":{"pass_start":"inside","entry":"helix"}}` now keeps `entry: helix` (issue probe 2).
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3843-start-side-arc.md` lists the named-entry case.
- The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #3863`.

## Results, merged with upstream/main `6d0381f19` (built locally, macOS)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 55 steps, 0 failed (4.9 min) |
| `offset_pass_start` (full suite) | 11 passed, 9 ignored |
| `example_catalog` | 41 passed, 4 ignored |
| `camcraft-ui --lib pass_start` | 13 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | **FAILED** (see blocker 1) |

Extra suites run: `example_catalog`, the full `offset_pass_start`, `cut_recipe` (in the quick gate), `camcraft-ui --lib pass_start`. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or the importers.

## Mutations (safety tier)

1. Remove the law line in `CreateOperation::build` (`create.rs:151`): `mcp_add_operation_with_start_side_takes_arc` goes red. The other three pins stay green.
2. Disable the `named_entry` early return in `start_side_entry.rs:26`: `mcp_edit_operation_with_explicit_helix_and_start_side_keeps_helix` goes red.

Each pin catches its half of the change.

## Requested before merge

1. **Clippy fails** at `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:391` and `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:398`:
   ```
   error: unnecessary closure used with `bool::then`
      --> crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:391:5
   error: unnecessary closure used with `bool::then`
      --> crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:398:5
   ```
   Upstream main does not have this error. The `undo` / `redo` rewrite and the `use` reorder at the top of `edit.rs` are not part of #3863. Revert these lines to the `if !env.history.undo(...)` form of main.

2. **A cut recipe no longer keeps its saved Helix entry** (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/create.rs:149-151`, reached from `crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs:54`).
   `CreateOperation::build` now applies the law against the seed for every create. `ApplyCutRecipe` calls `CreateOperation::new`, so `named_entry` is `false`. A 2D Offset recipe with `pass_start: outside` and `entry: helix` is a legal, explicit user choice (#3843 keeps "a Helix that the user selects again"). When the user applies that recipe, the new operation gets `entry: arc`. This is the same class of defect that #3863 fixes: the user's named entry is replaced, and the posted program changes with no message.
   Probe (local MCP test, not committed):
   - `add_operation` 2D Offset `O1`; `edit_operation {"pass_start":"outside"}` (gives Arc); `edit_operation {"entry":"helix"}` (gives Helix, kept).
   - `save_cut_recipe` from `O1`; `apply_cut_recipe` as `O2`.
   - With this PR: `O1` entry `helix`, `O2` entry `arc`.
   - With the create-door law removed (behaviour of main): `O2` entry `helix`.

   Fix: apply the create-door law only where the request starts from the seed. For example, call `CreateOperation::with_named_entry(..., true)` in `ApplyCutRecipe::new`, because a recipe holds a complete, saved parameter set. Another option: apply the law in the MCP `add_operation` door only, and keep `CreateOperation::new` as it is on main. Add a pinning test in `crates/app/tests/cut_recipe.rs` (or in `offset_pass_start/start_side_entry.rs`): a recipe with Outside and Helix applies as Outside and Helix.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The GUI create door (`crates/ui/src/actions.rs:436`) and the pocket-recognition door send Auto params, so the new law has no effect there. I found no other create caller with a start-side 2D Offset.
- The issue says that a GUI page that sends the start side and the entry in one edit can have the same problem. This PR fixes the MCP door only, as the issue "Done means" asks.

When the two items are fixed, please push and ask for a re-check. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Flagged ready after a quick pass. The review comes on a ready PR (AGENTS.md).

- The branch merges cleanly with `main` `3b4c4b2cb` (merge commit `f4390a9e4`).
- The quick gate is green on this head: 55 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (5.5 min), including `app build`, `app suites: lib` and all 52 mapped suites.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start`: 11 passed, 9 ignored (the heavy fig8 tests); all four `start_side_entry` pins pass.
- `git status --short -- crates/app/tests/golden` is empty.

The review runs on this head.

## Correction: `needs-rework` restored

This PR already has a collaborator review on this head (`0d695b266`, 13:38:54Z) with a **needs changes** verdict. I missed it because I read only the reviews endpoint and not the PR comments.

I set `needs-rework` again. The ready flag stays (AGENTS.md, #3727: a ready PR keeps its flag while its author fixes a `needs-rework` finding).

The two findings stand:
1. `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:391` and `:398` — clippy: "unnecessary closure used with `bool::then`" (undo/redo rewrite, outside #3863).
2. `crates/app/src/commands/operation/create.rs:149-151` (reached from `recipe.rs:54`) — `CreateOperation::build` applies the create-time law for every create, so `ApplyCutRecipe` overwrites a recipe's saved `entry: helix` with `arc`. That is the same class of defect #3863 fixes.

Addressed review items in commit 4337ecce5:
1. Clippy in MCP edit: Reverted undo and redo in \crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs\ to standard control flow. Clippy passes with zero warnings.
2. Cut recipe entry overwrite: Updated \crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs\ to call \CreateOperation::with_named_entry(..., true)\ in \ApplyCutRecipe::new\. This change ensures that explicit entry settings saved in cut recipes are not overwritten with arc.
3. Added pinning test \cut_recipe_keeps_explicit_helix_on_start_side_offset\ in \crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start/start_side_entry.rs\.

Verification passed:
- \cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start --test cut_recipe\ (31 passed: 20 cut_recipe + 11 offset_pass_start)
- \cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings\ (clean)
- Line counts: \ecipe.rs\ (130 lines), \edit.rs\ (395 lines), \start_side_entry.rs\ (151 lines) - all <= 400 lines

Ready for a re-check.

Correction to the `review-cost` line of the review: the effort of this work is `high` (issue #3863 carries `effort:high`). The review comment said `medium` by a dispatch error.
